name: Eleanor Shackleton
summary: In the woods southwest of Brill, Eleanor Shackleton teaches travelers to live off Tirisfal's blighted land. This Forsaken outdoorswoman camps away from town and the Undercity. Pierce Shackleton and Samantha Shackleton share her surname, though their kinship is unknown.

sections.title: A Guide to the Glades
sections.body: Eleanor Shackleton camps in the haunted woods southwest of Brill, away from the Undercity. Newly awakened Forsaken often go to those settlements, but Eleanor teaches travelers to live off Tirisfal's blighted land. She shows them how to make camps, gather firewood, and keep up their trade crafts while roaming far from civilization's fires and kitchens.

sections.title: Ties from a Past Life
sections.body: Eleanor Shackleton shares her surname with Pierce Shackleton and Samantha Shackleton, who live in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. For an undead person, a family name may be the only tether to mortal life in the shattered remnants of Lordaeron. Whether the three are close kin or share only common ancestry, each serves the Forsaken in a different way across the blighted kingdom.

faq.q: Where can I find Eleanor Shackleton?
faq.answer: Eleanor Shackleton camps in the woods southwest of Brill in Tirisfal Glades, away from the main paved road.

faq.q: What does Eleanor Shackleton teach adventurers?
faq.answer: Eleanor Shackleton teaches wilderness survival, including camping, foraging, and practicing professions in the wild.

faq.q: Is Eleanor related to other Shackletons in Lordaeron?
faq.answer: Eleanor Shackleton shares her surname with Pierce Shackleton and Samantha Shackleton of the Undercity, though whether they are kin from before the Scourge claimed the kingdom is unknown.

faq.q: Why is she camping outside Brill instead of staying in town?
faq.answer: Eleanor Shackleton teaches fieldcraft and wilderness survival. Her camp in the woods lets her meet travelers where those skills are needed.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, learning to survive in the wilderness without familiar comforts matters. Eleanor helps newly risen brethren adapt to life in rough Tirisfal.
As a cook, you can learn from Eleanor how to make a field campfire and prepare meals away from civilized hearths. Her camp is a useful stop for cooks on the road.
